title: Phase 7, Bloemfontein (approx.): man, 31, kidnapped and stabbed to death; five arrested, 4 Oct
summary: A 31-year-old man was found stabbed to death in a street in Phase 7, a settlement in the Bloemspruit area of Bloemfontein, at about 06:00 on Sunday 4 October, after he was allegedly forced into a vehicle following an arg...
story: A 31-year-old man was found stabbed to death in a street in Phase 7, a settlement in the Bloemspruit area of Bloemfontein, at about 06:00 on Sunday 4 October, after he was allegedly forced into a vehicle following an argument, according to police. Police say he had been drinking with friends when an argument broke out with a group of strangers, who allegedly forced him into a black vehicle and drove away with him; paramedics declared him dead at the scene. A task team led by Bloemspruit detectives arrested five men aged 21 to 34, who were due in court on preliminary charges of kidnapping and murder. An arrest is not a conviction. The victim and the accused are not named. Sources: SAPS Free State statement, 4 October, and NovaNews, 5 October (Lt Col Thabo Covane). The map point is an area-level point in Phase 7 (Mangaung ward 51), not the street where he was found.
incident: Sun 4 Oct 2026, early hours; the man was found at about 06:00 (police). The time of the kidnapping and of death is not given.
location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. In the street in Phase 7, Bloemfontein (SAPS); NovaNews, quoting police, calls Phase 7 'a settlement in the Bloemspruit area'. Area placed on 30 Oct 2026: the IEC 2026 voting station list has the Smart Kids Day Care station at erf 31115 Phase 7, Bloemfontein, in Mangaung ward 51 (49400051); SABC News (13 Mar 2026) also describes ward 51 as Phase 7. The pin is that station's point (-29.20472, 26.27664, as published from the IEC list by The People's Register), in south-east Mangaung near Grootvlei. Uncertainty about 1.5 km. Not the street.
